items.title: Jane Ira Bloom interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 3, 1998
items.q: I was thinking last week I was listening to Ali Akbar Khan play North Indian Sarod.

ctx.x: Who do you like to listen to these days? Who or what?
I was thinking last week I was listening to Ali Akbar Khan play North Indian Sarod.
Oh everybody listens to that sure.
